title: Maturity notice sent
description: Advance deposit‑maturity notice. This event is sent when a deposit nears its maturity date and is issued for each account attachment once product‑level advance notices are enabled. The `external_account_id`, a`ccount_creation_datetime`, `current_term, and renewal_term` fields are populated at dispatch time.

product_id.title: Product ID
product_id.description: Product ID. Format is UUID v4.

maturity_date.title: Maturity date
maturity_date.description: Deposit maturity date. Displayed in RFC3339 format.

days_until_maturity.title: Days until maturity
days_until_maturity.description: Number of days until the deposit reaches maturity

description.title: Description
description.description: Description text for the maturity configuration

auto_renewal.title: Auto renewal
auto_renewal.description: Does the deposit auto-renew at maturity?

grace_period_days.title: Grace period days
grace_period_days.description: Number of days in the grace period after the maturity date

external_account_id.title: External account ID
external_account_id.description: The client-facing external account ID, resolved from the transaction banking account when the event is dispatched.

account_creation_datetime.title: Account creation date time
account_creation_datetime.description: Timestamp showing when the account was created, resolved from the transaction banking account at dispatch time. Presented in RFC3339 format..

current_term.title: Current term
current_term.description: The maturity period for the active account attachment, resolved at dispatch time and always present.

unit.title: Term unit
unit.description: The unit used for the term period

value.title: Term value
value.description: The number of units in the term period

renewal_term.title: Renewal term
renewal_term.description: The renewal term configured for the account attachment, resolved at dispatch time from the attachment override or, if absent, from the program‑level override. Set to `null` when no renewal term exists at either level.

unit.title: Term unit
unit.description: The unit used for the term period

value.title: Term value
value.description: The number of units in the term period
